```artifact
Feature: Doctor and Chemist/Lab Management

  Scenario: Add a new Doctor
    Given the system is running
    When a new Doctor with name "Dr. John", age "45", sex "Male", qualification "MBBS", experience "10", and speciality "Cardiology" is added
    Then the Doctor should be added successfully
    And the Doctor's details should be displayed

  Scenario: Update Doctor details
    Given a Doctor with name "Dr. John" and speciality "Cardiology" exists
    When the Doctor's speciality is updated to "Neurology"
    Then the update should fail
    And the Doctor's speciality should remain "Cardiology"

  Scenario: Delete Doctor details
    Given a Doctor with name "Dr. John" and no pending requests exists
    When the Doctor is deleted
    Then the Doctor should be deleted successfully
    And the Doctor's details should no longer be displayed

  Scenario: Add a new Chemist or Lab
    Given the system is running
    When a new Chemist or Lab with name "Chemist1" and pincode "12345" is added
    Then the Chemist or Lab should be added successfully
    And the Chemist or Lab's details should be displayed

  Scenario: Update Chemist or Lab details
    Given a Chemist or Lab with name "Chemist1" and pincode "12345" exists
    When the Chemist or Lab's pincode is updated to "54321"
    Then the update should fail
    And the Chemist or Lab's pincode should remain "12345"

  Scenario: Delete Chemist or Lab details
    Given a Chemist or Lab with name "Chemist1" and no pending prescriptions exists
    When the Chemist or Lab is deleted
    Then the Chemist or Lab should be deleted successfully
    And the Chemist or Lab's details should no longer be displayed

  Scenario Outline: Add a new Doctor with edge and invalid values
    Given the system is running
    When a new Doctor with name "<name>", age "<age>", sex "<sex>", qualification "<qualification>", experience "<experience>", and speciality "<speciality>" is added
    Then the Doctor should be added successfully
    And the Doctor's details should be displayed

    Examples:
      | name    | age | sex | qualification | experience | speciality |
      |---------|-----|-----|---------------|------------|------------|
      | Dr. John| 45  | Male| MBBS          | 10         | Cardiology |
      | Dr. Jane| 30  | Female| MD            | 5          | Pediatrics |
      | Dr. Mike| 50  | Male| DO            | 20         | Surgery    |

  Scenario Outline: Update Doctor details with edge and invalid values
    Given a Doctor with name "<name>" and speciality "<speciality>" exists
    When the Doctor's speciality is updated to "<new_speciality>"
    Then the update should fail
    And the Doctor's speciality should remain "<speciality>"

    Examples:
      | name    | speciality | new_speciality |
      |---------|------------|----------------|
      | Dr. John| Cardiology | Neurology      |
      | Dr. Jane| Pediatrics | Surgery        |
      | Dr. Mike| Surgery    | Cardiology     |

  Scenario Outline: Delete Doctor details with edge and invalid values
    Given a Doctor with name "<name>" and <pending_requests> pending requests exists
    When the Doctor is deleted
    Then the deletion should fail
    And the Doctor's details should remain displayed

    Examples:
      | name    | pending_requests |
      |---------|------------------|
      | Dr. John| 1                |
      | Dr. Jane| 0                |
      | Dr. Mike| 2                |

  Scenario Outline: Add a new Chemist or Lab with edge and invalid values
    Given the system is running
    When a new Chemist or Lab with name "<name>" and pincode "<pincode>" is added
    Then the Chemist or Lab should be added successfully
    And the Chemist or Lab's details should be displayed

    Examples:
      | name    | pincode |
      |---------|---------|
      | Chemist1| 12345   |
      | Chemist2| 54321   |
      | Chemist3| 67890   |

  Scenario Outline: Update Chemist or Lab details with edge and invalid values
    Given a Chemist or Lab with name "<name>" and pincode "<pincode>" exists
    When the Chemist or Lab's pincode is updated to "<new_pincode>"
    Then the update should fail
    And the Chemist or Lab's pincode should remain "<pincode>"

    Examples:
      | name    | pincode | new_pincode |
      |---------|---------|-------------|
      | Chemist1| 12345   | 54321       |
      | Chemist2| 54321   | 67890       |
      | Chemist3| 67890   | 12345       |

  Scenario Outline: Delete Chemist or Lab details with edge and invalid values
    Given a Chemist or Lab with name "<name>" and <pending_prescriptions> pending prescriptions exists
    When the Chemist or Lab is deleted
    Then the deletion should fail
    And the Chemist or Lab's details should remain displayed

    Examples:
      | name    | pending_prescriptions |
      |---------|-----------------------|
      | Chemist1| 1                     |
      | Chemist2| 0                     |
      | Chemist3| 2                     |
```
